summary: Co-Diagnostics, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing entry into a Loan Agreement with J.J. Astor Co. for up to $3.1 million in senior secured convertible notes. An initial $2.1 million loan was funded, issuing a $2.835 million note at a 1.35x factor, with a 4% origination fee yielding about $2.016 million net. A $1.0 million additional note may be drawn within 60 days. Notes are secured by substantially all assets, payable in 30 weekly installments, with a $250,000 minimum cash covenant and conversion features only upon default. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event.
